advocate_mode.best_defense: The dome SAA was specifically a decade-long locus of accelerated geodynamo change — calling the SAA "regional" understates how globally relevant it is. PROS-007 is genuinely confirmed by SAA data because the SAA dominates contemporary global field change. Annualization-vs-cumulative is a quibble: 30 nT in 14 months is still ~28 nT in 12 months under linear extrapolation (28.6), bracketing the threshold within measurement noise; the dome’s prediction is operationally vindicated. The summary line’s third clause ("threshold set within established trend guarantees confirmation") is harsh: any vindicated forecast must use a threshold within the parameter range that observation could fall in; that’s how thresholds work. Calling this "guaranteed" is a no-true-Scotsman move against successful prediction.

kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: A regional cumulative measurement does not vindicate a global prediction. The prediction text demands "global geomagnetic field would have decayed by at least 28 nT" (raw-text/02-wins.txt:43, PROS-007), and the confirmation text concedes "SAA region alone" (raw-text/02-wins.txt:45, W011). Cumulative ~30 nT passes 28 only because the dome’s own 14-month window is 17% longer than the 12-month spec — when normalized to the spec, ~25.7 nT/yr fails the dome’s own "per year" model parameter (raw-text/05-model.txt:42). The patch closes the WIN-037.c6 self-undercut on the summary line; it does not blunt the substance, because detail_evidence still carries the annualization correctly.
